description:
Resolve the architectural code smell of having two parallel platform registration systems
that can drift apart. Currently, new platforms must be registered in BOTH:

1. `get_platform_adapter()` in `benchbox/platforms/__init__.py` (hardcoded dict, 22 entries)
2. `PlatformRegistry.auto_register_platforms()` in `benchbox/core/platform_registry.py` (18 entries)

The systems serve different purposes:
- `get_platform_adapter()`: CLI routing + adapter instantiation (with alias support)
- `PlatformRegistry`: Metadata + discovery + availability (no alias support)

This has caused bugs where platforms were added to one system but not the other.
